assumptions: No live human was available; the fleet's settled defaults answered the open questions (proposal.md, Decisions made).
A vacuous finding is fixed by making the test exercise its target; an absence-only test with no in-test precondition is fixed by pinning the denominator in that test.
A false positive is recorded, not suppressed: cassandra has no suppression mechanism and none is invented. The false-positive shapes are filed once, in #1231.

The 'newly exposed' set is re-measured as findings under this branch's engine that disappear when only the #1175 function-body boundary is reverted (`return sibling;`), on the current tree. #1179's count of 16 was taken at #1175's merge, and tests have been added since.

Approach A (an optional one-line annotation in JS_LOCAL_DECL) is chosen over stripping types or an AST parse. It misses multi-line annotations and object types with ';' members, which is the safe direction: a missed declaration leaves a finding standing and never silences one.
The @covers bug found during triage (#1232) is filed, not fixed here, so @covers was not used as a remedy.
